profile_text.body:
Zscaler is a publicly traded cloud enterprise security company, listed on Nasdaq under the ticker ZS (CIK 0001713683), that describes itself as a leading provider helping global businesses adopt zero trust architecture for secure digital transformation. The company's core offering is a cloud-native cybersecurity platform that it says is built on zero trust principles to protect users, workloads, branches, and devices, and which it describes as the world's largest inline security cloud.

Zscaler's AI product, tracked here as Zscaler AI, sits within the Security and Identity AI category and encompasses its Secure Service Edge platform, data loss prevention capabilities, and AI traffic inspection. The company positions this platform as purpose-built for what it calls the AI Age, framing zero trust as the foundational architecture for organizations navigating AI-driven digital environments. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or patent filings are present in the held data.
